title.narrative: Activity under preparation Support Measures for Cambodia ¿ EU Cooperation Facility, Strategic Communication and Support to Civil Society Organisations

description.narrative: This action will support the implementation of the EU¿s strategic priorities in Cambodia, with a particular focus on Global Gateway. It will cover three support measures, namely the Support Measures ¿ Cooperation Facility, the Support Measures - Strategic Communication and the Support Measures ¿ Support to Civil Society, in line with ARES note Ares(2024)3816171 on the transfer of responsibilities for the programming and implementation of the Support Measures appropriations to EU Delegations in Asia and the Pacific. In addition, the support measures will promote engagement with Civil Society Organisations, to act at all levels fulfilling their roles to ensure integrity and impact of Global Gateway Investments, in particular in the Energy Transition and water sectors, in line with the updated EU civil society roadmap for Cambodia and the EU¿s 360-degree approach.The Support Measures - Cooperation Facility (EUR 3.5 million) will enhance the efficiency, performance, and impact of EU programmes in Cambodia. It provides the Delegation with the flexibility to finance small-scale activities required to achieve the objectives of the Neighbourhood, Development and International Cooperation Instrument (NDICI-Global Europe) as outlined in the MIP priority areas. It will notably provide necessary administrative or technical assistance for programme formulation, implementation, M&E actions. It will also assist the Delegation in policy dialogue and public diplomacy with various stakeholders, including civil society actors, and strengthen EU engagement and EU-Cambodia partnership, in existing sectors through higher education, skills development, research, and innovation. This component is expected to start in 2028 and will build on the already ongoing cooperation facility action, contracted in 2024 and funded by Support Measures appropriations to EU Delegations in Asia and the Pacific.The Support Measures - Strategic Communication (EUR 2.5 million) activities will be designed to raise awareness, understanding and perception of the EU and its partnership with Cambodia, in line with the existing priorities, in particular through Global Gateway flagships and Team Europe initiatives and programmes. Strategic Communication will serve to strengthen EU¿s position as a trusted and reliable partner of reference for Cambodia. An increased alignment of EU communication with EU foreign policies will significantly enhance the visibility and understanding of the EU relations and partnership with Cambodia. This component is expected to start in late 2027 and will build on the already ongoing Strategic Communication action, contracted in 2020. The Support measures ¿ Support to Civil Society (EUR 3 million) activities will strengthen civil society participation, empowering CSOs to fulfil their roles by engaging in policy discussions with more technical expertise, especially when it comes to key governance processes and social accountability and advocacy for a Just Energy transition and promoting a human rights-based approach, inclusivity and gender equality. We will also support advocacy and awareness and reinforcing monitoring and accountability mechanisms of public and private operators.
